import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    R = int(data[0])
    out = []
    for i in range(1, R + 1):
        letters = ''.join(chr(65 + j) for j in range(i))
        numbers = ''.join(str(j) for j in range(1, i + 1))
        out.append(letters + numbers)
    sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(out))

main()
